gloss: stopping; halting; staying in one place

definitions.explanation: The act of stopping and remaining in one place, especially used for vehicles at designated stops or for things that stay in a fixed position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}ります→降りる：00568_oriru⟧。
examples.english: I'll get off at the next stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: The bus is approaching the stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{路面|ろめん}{電車|でんしゃ}→路面電車：14282_romendensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}して→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please drive carefully around here since there are many streetcar stops.

notes:
Compound of {停|てい} (halt) + {留|りゅう} (stay/remain). Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧ (bus stop/tram stop), which is one of the first words visitors to Japan learn for navigating public transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧: bus stop; tram stop
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧: bus stop
- ⟦{路面|ろめん}{電車|でんしゃ}→路面電車：14282_romendensha⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧: streetcar stop
- {停留|ていりゅう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: stopping time; dwell time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{停車|ていしゃ}→停車：04534_teisha⟧: stopping (of a vehicle) — specifically about a vehicle stopping temporarily, not the place
- ⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: halt; cessation — broader; can mean stopping any activity or process
- ⟦{滞留|たいりゅう}→滞留：25835_tairyuu⟧: staying; lingering — implies remaining longer than expected
- ⟦バス{停|てい}→バス停：05295_basutei⟧: bus stop (abbreviated form) — casual abbreviation often seen on maps
